participants.note: Concept ACK, but asked for clearer error message for IPv6-only hosts (resolved)

claims.harm: an IPv6-only host will fail startup without actionable error guidance to override -rpcbind
claims.quote: with the new defaults, an IPv6-only host will fail because the required 127.0.0.1 bind will never succeed, but the user may not know that they need to override -rpcbind to use only their IPv6 address
claims.settled_by_quote: Good point. Default behavior for IPv6-only hosts should at least be to get an informative error message.

support.reason: this makes sense since `bitcoin-cli` defaults to IPv4, so `bitcoind` should have a corresponding IPv4 listener, already working by default as well

result.notes: Confirmed winterrdog's interface concern regarding uninformative errors on IPv6-only hosts, which the author resolved with a pushed fix. Dropped janb84's comments on logging level and style as non-blocking nits.
